message:
Migrate auth to auth.romaine.life delegation (drop MSAL + per-app allowlist)

Replaces kill-me's bespoke Microsoft sign-in (MSAL frontend → /auth/microsoft/login
backend → shared HS256 JWT signed with `api-jwt-signing-secret`) with delegated
auth to auth.romaine.life. Microsoft sign-in happens upstream; this app verifies
the upstream RS256 JWT against auth.romaine.life's JWKS, gates on the role claim,
and mints its own HS256 session JWT for downstream API calls.

Closes the kill-me side of nelsong6/auth#16. Mirrors the canonical template
established by nelsong6/tank-operator#472.

Pattern
-------
- Frontend (frontend/src/auth/index.js): bootstrapAuth → startLogin → logout.
  Silent exchange on boot via `auth.romaine.life/api/auth/token` cookie (the
  .romaine.life session cookie is auto-attached cross-origin). startLogin redirects
  to `${auth_url}/sign-in/microsoft?callbackURL=...` — the GET wrapper, not the
  POST-only Better Auth route (per tank-operator PR #474).
- Backend (backend/auth-routes.js + backend/auth.js): POST /api/auth/exchange with
  `{auth_jwt}` body. exchangeRomaineLifeToken verifies RS256 against
  https://auth.romaine.life/api/auth/jwks (jose's createRemoteJWKSet handles
  caching), pins issuer = https://auth.romaine.life, accepts role ∈ {admin,
  user} only — `pending` gets 403. No per-app email allowlist.
- Local session JWT: HS256, signed with `kill-me-jwt-signing-secret` (already
  provisioned in tofu/keyvault.tf, just newly wired in config.js). Carries the
  upstream role claim through so requireAuth/requireAdmin gate locally without
  re-hitting auth.romaine.life on every request.

End-to-end deletions (per tank-operator/docs/migration-policy.md)
----------------------------------------------------------------
- backend/microsoft-routes.js (entire file)
- frontend/src/auth/msal.js (entire file)
- @azure/msal-browser from frontend/package.json
- jwks-rsa from backend/package.json (only used for Microsoft JWKS); jose added
- ALLOWED_EMAIL constant + nelson-devops-project@outlook.com hardcoded address
- config.js's listConfigurationSettings() enumeration of `*/microsoft_oauth_client_id`
- config.js read of shared `api-jwt-signing-secret` → per-app `kill-me-jwt-signing-secret`
- Dockerfile VITE_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID build arg
- docker-build-check.yaml VITE_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID build arg
- build-and-deploy.yaml "Fetch MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID from App Configuration" step
- tofu/oauth.tf (entire file — the per-app Entra app registration)
- tofu/appconfig.tf (entire file — only had the microsoft_oauth_client_id key)
- tofu/identity.tf KV scope flipped to kill-me-jwt-signing-secret
- CLAUDE.md auth model + data flow + .env docs rewritten

Guard
-----
scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs greps every committed file for the retired
patterns (MSAL imports, /auth/microsoft/login route, ALLOWED_EMAILS,
api-jwt-signing-secret, VITE_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID, microsoft_oauth_client_id key,
jwks-rsa, etc.) and exits non-zero. Wired as `check-removed-msal` job in
.github/workflows/lint.yaml so reintroduction breaks CI at PR time.

Supersedes PR #32, which predated the canonical template (it fetched
/api/auth/token client-side and POSTed to /api/auth/sign-in/social/microsoft —
both wrong). #32 to be closed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

issue.body:
## Summary

Replaces this app's bespoke auth (MSAL frontend → Microsoft ID token → shared HS256 JWT) with delegated auth to [auth.romaine.life](https://github.com/nelsong6/auth). Pattern-proof PR for the same migration coming to plant-agent, investing, house-hunt, and fzt-frontend.

**Before:** Frontend uses MSAL to get a Microsoft ID token → POSTs it to `/auth/microsoft/login` → backend verifies against Microsoft JWKS, upserts a Cosmos user record, issues a self-signed JWT with the shared `api-jwt-signing-secret` → frontend stores it in localStorage.

**After:** Frontend redirects to `auth.romaine.life/api/auth/sign-in/social/microsoft?callbackURL=...`. After the Microsoft dance, the auth service sets a session cookie scoped to `.romaine.life`. Frontend fetches `auth.romaine.life/api/auth/token` (cookie auto-attached), gets an RS256 JWT, stores in localStorage, sends as `Bearer`. Backend verifies via `auth.romaine.life/api/auth/jwks` using `jose`'s `createRemoteJWKSet` + `jwtVerify`.

### Files

**Deleted:**
- [`backend/microsoft-routes.js`](backend/microsoft-routes.js) — entire Microsoft token-exchange + JWT issuance moves to the auth service
- [`frontend/src/auth/msal.js`](frontend/src/auth/msal.js) — MSAL gone

**Rewritten:**
- [`backend/auth.js`](backend/auth.js) — `jsonwebtoken`+`jwks-rsa` → `jose` (`createRemoteJWKSet` + `jwtVerify`)
- [`backend/config.js`](backend/config.js) — drops `api-jwt-signing-secret` KV fetch and Microsoft client-ID enumeration; now only reads `cosmos_db_endpoint` from App Configuration
- [`frontend/src/auth/AuthContext.jsx`](frontend/src/auth/AuthContext.jsx) — on-mount JWT fetch from auth service, silent refresh 60 s before `exp`, `signIn`/`signOut` redirect helpers. Same `useAuth()` shape as before so callers don't change.

**Trimmed:**
- [`backend/server.js`](backend/server.js) — drops Microsoft routes mount
- [`backend/package.json`](backend/package.json) — out: `jsonwebtoken`, `jwks-rsa`, `@azure/keyvault-secrets`; in: `jose`
- [`frontend/package.json`](frontend/package.json) — out: `@azure/msal-browser`
- [`frontend/src/api/client.js`](frontend/src/api/client.js), [`frontend/src/components/UserProfile.jsx`](frontend/src/components/UserProfile.jsx) — swap `loginWithMicrosoft` for the new redirect/`signIn`
- [`Dockerfile`](Dockerfile) — drop `VITE_MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID` build arg
- [`.github/workflows/build-and-deploy.yaml`](.github/workflows/build-and-deploy.yaml) — drop the App Configuration fetch that fed that build arg
- [`k8s/deployment.yaml`](k8s/deployment.yaml) — drop `KEY_VAULT_URL` env (no Key Vault reads from the pod anymore)

## Test plan

- [ ] Build and Deploy workflow succeeds (image builds without the MS client ID build arg)
- [ ] After ArgoCD rolls the new image, hit `workout.romaine.life` while signed in to auth.romaine.life → should auto-fetch a JWT and load with user identity
- [ ] Click Sign In while signed out → redirects to auth.romaine.life Microsoft flow → returns to workout.romaine.life signed in
- [ ] Sign Out → cookie cleared on auth.romaine.life, localStorage cleared on workout.romaine.life, user back to anonymous
- [ ] Admin tab visibility honors `user.role === 'admin'` — currently `member` until the auth service's user record has `role` updated (see below)
- [ ] After signing in, API requests to `workout.romaine.life/api/*` carry the JWT as `Bearer` and the backend's JWKS verification accepts them

## Notes for sequencing

- **User data:** existing Cosmos records keyed by `microsoft|<MS-sub>` won't match the new JWT `sub` (which is Better Auth's random user.id). For a single-user system this is a fresh start. Old records will just sit there unreferenced until you clean them up.
- **Admin role:** after first sign-in, the auth service's `user` table has `role = 'user'` (default). Mark yourself admin with a one-time SQL against the auth Postgres pod: `UPDATE "user" SET role='admin' WHERE email='nelson@romaine.life';`. The JWT will pick it up on next token fetch.
- **Old microsoft-login SPA redirects** (`https://workout.romaine.life/`) remain on the [`microsoft_login` app reg](https://github.com/nelsong6/infra-bootstrap/blob/main/tofu/oauth.tf) for now. After all 5 apps migrate, a final infra-bootstrap PR drops the SPA list entirely.

## Summary

Replaces investing's bespoke Microsoft sign-in (browser MSAL → POST \`/auth/microsoft/login\` → shared HS256 JWT) with delegated auth to [auth.romaine.life](https://auth.romaine.life). Microsoft sign-in happens upstream; this app verifies the upstream RS256 JWT against auth.romaine.life's JWKS, gates on the role claim (\`admin\`/\`user\` only — \`pending\` gets 403), and mints its own HS256 session JWT for downstream API calls. Mirrors [kill-me#34](https://github.com/nelsong6/kill-me/pull/34) (the Node mirror of [tank-operator#472](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/pull/472)).

Closes the investing side of [nelsong6/auth#16](https://github.com/nelsong6/auth/issues/16).

## Pattern

- **Frontend** ([frontend/auth.js](frontend/auth.js)): vanilla JS module with \`bootstrapAuth/startLogin/logout\` exports. \`script.js\` calls \`bootstrapAuth()\` on init, shows the Sign-in button if null, calls \`startLogin()\` on click. No CDN MSAL script tag; no build-time \`config.js\` generation — \`auth_url\` is fetched at runtime from \`/api/config\`.
- **Backend** ([backend/auth-routes.js](backend/auth-routes.js) + [backend/auth.js](backend/auth.js)): \`POST /api/auth/exchange\` with \`{auth_jwt}\` body. Verifies RS256 against \`https://auth.romaine.life/api/auth/jwks\` (jose's \`createRemoteJWKSet\`), pins issuer = \`https://auth.romaine.life\`, accepts \`role ∈ {admin, user}\` only.
- **Local session JWT**: HS256, signed with \`investing-jwt-signing-secret\` (already in [tofu/keyvault.tf](tofu/keyvault.tf), just newly wired in \`config.js\`).

## End-to-end deletions

| Deleted | Why |
|---|---|
| \`backend/microsoft-routes.js\` | Replaced by \`auth-routes.js\` |
| \`frontend/config.js.example\` + \`generate-config.sh\` | No build-time MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID needed |
| \`jwks-rsa\` dep | Only used for Microsoft JWKS; \`jose\` replaces it |
| \`ALLOWED_EMAIL\` + hardcoded email | Role claim is the only gate |
| \`config.js\` \`listConfigurationSettings()\` | No per-app Microsoft client IDs to discover |
| \`config.js\` read of \`api-jwt-signing-secret\` | Per-app secret instead |
| Workflow \"Generate frontend/config.js\" steps | No client-id in the bundle anymore |
| \`tofu/oauth.tf\` | Per-app Entra app registration + App Config key publishing |
| \`tofu/outputs.tf\` \`app_config_prefix\` output | Was only consumed by the deleted oauth.tf |
| \`tofu/identity.tf\` KV scope | Flipped to \`investing-jwt-signing-secret\` |
| Index.html CDN MSAL script tag | No MSAL in the page |

## Guard

[scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs](scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs) greps every committed file for retired patterns and exits non-zero. Wired as a CI job in \`.github/workflows/lint.yaml\`.

## Drive-bys

- \`.gitignore\`: add \`packages/\` (legacy npm workspace leftover with recursive node_modules that causes git long-path errors on Windows) and \`backend/node_modules/\` (was missing; only frontend was ignored).

## Test plan

- [x] \`node scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs\` returns clean
- [ ] **Phase 0 (auth#18 + auth#19) deployed**: \`curl -i -X OPTIONS -H \"Origin: https://investing.romaine.life\" -H \"Access-Control-Request-Method: GET\" https://auth.romaine.life/api/auth/token\` returns ACA header for \`investing.romaine.life\` (added in auth#19)
- [ ] After image rolls: \`investing.romaine.life\` shows Sign-in button when unauthenticated
- [ ] Click Sign in → redirects to auth.romaine.life → returns signed in
- [ ] Already signed into another \`.romaine.life\` app → silent SSO on reload
- [ ] Sign Out → cookies cleared on both auth.romaine.life and investing.romaine.life
- [ ] Demote to \`pending\` in auth.romaine.life/admin → next bootstrap 403s

## Summary

Replaces house-hunt's bespoke Microsoft sign-in (browser MSAL → POST \`/auth/microsoft/login\` → shared HS256 JWT) with delegated auth to [auth.romaine.life](https://auth.romaine.life). Microsoft sign-in happens upstream; this app verifies the upstream RS256 JWT against auth.romaine.life's JWKS, gates on the role claim, and mints its own HS256 session JWT. Mirrors [investing#16](https://github.com/nelsong6/investing/pull/16) and [kill-me#34](https://github.com/nelsong6/kill-me/pull/34).

Closes the house-hunt side of [nelsong6/auth#16](https://github.com/nelsong6/auth/issues/16).

## Pattern

- **Frontend** ([frontend/auth.js](frontend/auth.js)): vanilla JS module with \`initAuth/login/logout\` (plus \`getToken/getUser/isAuthenticated\` for the existing \`script.js\` call sites). \`initAuth\` tries stored token → silent exchange via .romaine.life cookie → null. \`login\` redirects to \`auth.romaine.life/sign-in/microsoft\`.
- **Backend** ([backend/auth-routes.js](backend/auth-routes.js) + [backend/auth.js](backend/auth.js)): \`POST /api/auth/exchange\` with \`{auth_jwt}\` body. Verifies RS256 against \`https://auth.romaine.life/api/auth/jwks\` (jose), pins issuer, accepts \`role ∈ {admin, user}\` only.
- **Local session JWT**: HS256, signed with **\`house-hunt-jwt-signing-secret\`** (NEW — see Drive-bys; house-hunt had no per-app secret pre-migration).

## End-to-end deletions

| Deleted | Why |
|---|---|
| \`backend/microsoft-routes.js\` | Replaced by \`auth-routes.js\` |
| \`@azure/cosmos\` dep | Only used for account records during MS-OIDC exchange; auth.romaine.life owns the user table now |
| \`jwks-rsa\` dep | Microsoft JWKS; \`jose\` replaces it for the upstream JWKS |
| \`ALLOWED_EMAIL\` + hardcoded email | Role claim is the only gate |
| \`config.js\` listConfigurationSettings + cosmos_db_endpoint read | Microsoft client IDs + Cosmos no longer needed |
| \`config.js\` read of \`api-jwt-signing-secret\` | Per-app secret instead |
| \`@azure/msal-browser\` CDN script tag in index.html | No MSAL |
| \`microsoftClientId\` from frontend/config.js + generate-config.sh | No client ID in the bundle |
| Workflow MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID fetch step + build arg | Not needed |
| \`tofu/oauth.tf\` | Per-app Entra app reg + App Config publishing |
| \`tofu/identity.tf\` Cosmos role assignment + cosmos data block | Not reading Cosmos anymore |
| \`tofu/identity.tf\` KV scope | Flipped to \`house-hunt-jwt-signing-secret\` |
| CLAUDE.md auth/data flow sections | Rewritten to describe new flow |

## Drive-bys

- **\`tofu/keyvault.tf\` NEW**: provisions \`house-hunt-jwt-signing-secret\`. House-hunt was the only app reusing the shared \`api-jwt-signing-secret\` instead of having its own (kill-me/investing/plant-agent all have per-app secrets in their tofu).
- **Rename .yml → .yaml**: \`.github/workflows/build-and-deploy.yml\` and \`tofu.yml\` renamed to \`.yaml\` to match the org-wide standard enforced by the shared lint template (added below).
- **Add lint.yaml**: \`.github/workflows/lint.yaml\` with the shared code-quality template + the new \`check-removed-msal\` job. House-hunt had no lint workflow before; the YAML-extension check would have failed on the .yml files until they were renamed.

## Guard

[scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs](scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs) greps every committed file for retired patterns and exits non-zero. Wired as \`check-removed-msal\` in \`.github/workflows/lint.yaml\`.

## Test plan

- [x] \`node scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs\` returns clean
- [ ] **Phase 0 (auth#18 + auth#19) deployed**: \`curl -i -X OPTIONS -H \"Origin: https://househunt.romaine.life\" -H \"Access-Control-Request-Method: GET\" https://auth.romaine.life/api/auth/token\` returns ACA header for \`househunt.romaine.life\` (added in auth#19)
- [ ] **tofu plan applies cleanly**: new \`house-hunt-jwt-signing-secret\` provisioned; cosmos role assignment removed; oauth.tf resources destroyed
- [ ] After image rolls: \`househunt.romaine.life\` map loads anonymously; Sign-in button visible
- [ ] Click Sign in → redirects to auth.romaine.life → returns signed in; admin controls appear
- [ ] Property edits work (write path through Bearer JWT)
- [ ] Sign Out → both cookies cleared → back to anonymous
- [ ] Demote to \`pending\` in auth.romaine.life/admin → next bootstrap 403s

issue.body:
## Summary

Replaces glimmung's bespoke Entra ID auth (browser MSAL popup → backend JWT verify against \`login.microsoftonline.com\` JWKS → email-allowlist gate) with delegated auth to [auth.romaine.life](https://auth.romaine.life). The dashboard redirects sign-in to \`auth.romaine.life/sign-in/microsoft\`; the resulting RS256 JWT is sent directly to the backend as \`Authorization: Bearer\`; the backend verifies against auth.romaine.life's JWKS, pins the issuer, and gates on the \`role\` claim (\`admin\`/\`user\` — \`pending\` returns 403). Admins promoted at [auth.romaine.life/admin](https://auth.romaine.life/admin).

Closes the glimmung side of [nelsong6/auth#16](https://github.com/nelsong6/auth/issues/16). Mirrors [tank-operator#472](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/pull/472) (canonical Go template) + the Node mirrors ([kill-me#34](https://github.com/nelsong6/kill-me/pull/34), [investing#16](https://github.com/nelsong6/investing/pull/16), [house-hunt#4](https://github.com/nelsong6/house-hunt/pull/4), [plant-agent#23](https://github.com/nelsong6/plant-agent/pull/23)).

## Pattern

- **Backend** ([internal/auth/romaine_life.go](internal/auth/romaine_life.go)): \`RomaineLifeAuthenticator\` verifies RS256 against \`https://auth.romaine.life/api/auth/jwks\` (in-process JWKS cache, 10min TTL), pins issuer to \`https://auth.romaine.life\`, accepts \`role ∈ {admin, user}\` only. Slots into the unchanged \`CompositeAuthenticator\` alongside the K8s SA-token path (cluster-issued tokens still flow through the K8s side, routed by JWT shape).
- **No glimmung-side mint**: verification happens on every request against the upstream JWKS (cached). Simpler than tank-operator's exchange-and-mint pattern — glimmung has no per-user profile state to bundle into a session token.
- **Frontend** ([frontend/src/auth.ts](frontend/src/auth.ts)): preserves existing exports (\`initAuth/currentAccount/signIn/signOut/getIdToken/publicConfig/authedFetch\`) but swaps MSAL for the canonical bootstrap. \`bootstrapAuth\` fetches an auth.romaine.life JWT via \`/api/auth/token\` (cookie auto-attached cross-origin); \`signIn\` redirects to \`auth.romaine.life/sign-in/microsoft?callbackURL=...\`; \`getIdToken\` refreshes from the upstream when within 60s of expiry.

## Slot-redirect reconciler deletion

Per migration-policy "delete dependencies in the same PR", the project-scoped Entra redirect-URI reconciler goes with the auth migration. In the new architecture, slot URLs sign in via \`callbackURL\` to auth.romaine.life (covered by the wildcard \`https://*.glimmung.dev.romaine.life\` in auth.romaine.life's trustedOrigins — added in [auth#20](https://github.com/nelsong6/auth/pull/20)), so no per-project Entra app reg needs its redirectUris reconciled.

**Deleted**: \`internal/entra/redirect_client.go\`, \`internal/server/native_auth_redirects.go\` (+ tests), the \`NativeAuthRedirectReconciler\`/\`Service\` types, the \`project_scale_api.go\` reconcile call, the Cosmos \`SetProjectNativeAuthRedirectStatus\` writer, the legacy \`native_standby_entra_redirects\` 422 rejection in \`project_write_api.go\`. **Per migration-policy** (re-confirmed before this PR), no new validation is added for the now-dead \`native_auth_redirects\` metadata field — old project documents that carry it are inert (no live code consumes it).

## End-to-end deletions

| Deleted | Why |
|---|---|
| \`internal/auth/entra.go\` + test | EntraAuthenticator + ALLOWED_EMAILS gate retired |
| \`internal/entra/\` (whole dir) | Only redirect_client.go was there |
| \`internal/server/native_auth_redirects.go\` + test | Reconciler dead code |
| \`@azure/msal-browser\` dep | No MSAL in the bundle |
| \`ENTRA_CLIENT_ID\` / \`ENTRA_TEST_CLIENT_ID\` / \`ALLOWED_EMAILS\` Settings + env + ExternalSecret keys | Verifier reaches the upstream JWKS directly |
| \`frontendEntraClientID\` / \`isDisposableFrontendHost\` / \`requestHost\` helpers | \`/v1/config\` no longer branches on host; returns \`{auth_url, tank_operator_base_url}\` |
| \`authRedirects\` positional param across 4 server constructors | Wiring for the deleted reconciler |
| \`tofu/oauth.tf\` | \`glimmung-oauth\` + \`glimmung-oauth-test\` Entra app regs + MS Graph \`Application.ReadWrite.All\` grant + published client-id KV secrets |
| \`tofu/admin-emails.tf\` | Role claim replaces the per-app list |
| \`tofu/variables.tf\` \`hostname\` + \`test_redirect_uris\` | Dead after \`oauth.tf\` deletion |
| README + docs/go-migration-contracts + docs/ui-package-design-portfolios sections | Rewritten to describe the new flow |
| \`IssueDetailView.tsx\` ALLOWED_EMAILS mentions in admin-restriction tooltips | Now reference \`auth.romaine.life/admin\` |

## Build helpers

\`internal/server/map_helpers.go\` (NEW): map-key utilities (\`stringMapValue\`, \`stringSliceFromMap\`, \`nonNegativeIntMapValue\`) extracted from the deleted \`native_auth_redirects.go\` since \`native_workload_identities.go\` still consumes them.

## Guard

[scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs](scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs) greps every committed file for retired patterns (MSAL imports, \`ENTRA_*\` env vars, \`ALLOWED_EMAILS\`, \`native_auth_redirects\`, \`glimmung-oauth-*\` KV secrets, \`Application.ReadWrite.*\` Graph permissions, \`login.microsoftonline.com\` URLs) and exits non-zero. Wired as a \`check-removed-msal\` job in \`.github/workflows/tests.yaml\`. Test fixture files (\`auth/k8s_test.go\`, \`auth/romaine_life_test.go\`) are exempt — they intentionally contain Microsoft URLs to verify the verifier rejects unexpected issuers.

## Verification

- [x] \`go build ./...\` clean
- [x] \`go test ./...\` — all packages pass (notable: \`internal/auth\` covers the new authenticator end-to-end with a JWKS test server)
- [x] \`cd frontend && npm run build\` clean
- [x] \`cd frontend && npm run test:run\` — 7/7 pass
- [x] \`node scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs\` returns clean
- [ ] **Phase 0 (auth#18 + auth#19) deployed**: \`curl -i -X OPTIONS -H \"Origin: https://glimmung.romaine.life\" -H \"Access-Control-Request-Method: GET\" https://auth.romaine.life/api/auth/token\` returns ACA header for \`glimmung.romaine.life\` (added in auth#18)
- [ ] After image rolls: \`glimmung.romaine.life\` Sign-in button redirects to auth.romaine.life → returns signed in
- [ ] Already signed into another \`.romaine.life\` app → silent SSO on glimmung reload
- [ ] Admin endpoints accept JWT from auth.romaine.life
- [ ] K8s SA-token path still works (tank-operator's MCP-attestation flow into glimmung)
- [ ] Slot URLs (\`https://*.glimmung.dev.romaine.life\`) sign in successfully via \`callbackURL\` redirect

## Notes for sequencing

- Old project documents in Cosmos that still carry \`native_auth_redirects: {...}\` metadata are now inert — no live code consumes them. Stays in storage as opaque blob; will eventually be pruned by background cleanup if anyone cares.
- The Entra app regs (\`glimmung-oauth\` + \`glimmung-oauth-test\`) get destroyed when tofu applies the deleted \`oauth.tf\`. The published \`glimmung-oauth-client-id\` + \`glimmung-oauth-test-client-id\` KV secrets go with them.
- Per migration-policy, no fallback / compatibility layer: this is a hard cutover. Once merged + rolled, every admin request must present an auth.romaine.life JWT (or a valid K8s SA token).

issue.body:
## Summary

Every per-app browser MSAL flow that used to authenticate against this app reg has retired:

| App | Migration PR |
|---|---|
| workout/kill-me | [kill-me#34](https://github.com/nelsong6/kill-me/pull/34) |
| plants/plant-agent | [plant-agent#23](https://github.com/nelsong6/plant-agent/pull/23) |
| investing | [investing#16](https://github.com/nelsong6/investing/pull/16) |
| househunt/house-hunt | [house-hunt#4](https://github.com/nelsong6/house-hunt/pull/4) |
| glimmung | [glimmung#498](https://github.com/nelsong6/glimmung/pull/498) |
| homepage | switched to terminal-minted JWT earlier (no MSAL) |

All of them now sign in via [auth.romaine.life](https://auth.romaine.life), which uses **this** app reg's \`web\` flow (authorization-code-with-client-secret) to do the upstream Microsoft handshake on their behalf. The \`single_page_application.redirect_uris\` block listed only callers that no longer exist; per [tank-operator/docs/migration-policy.md](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/blob/main/docs/migration-policy.md), retired surface gets deleted end-to-end with no fallback.

**What stays**: the application itself, the password, the KV secrets that auth.romaine.life reads (\`microsoft-oauth-client-id\`, \`microsoft-oauth-client-secret\`), and the \`web\` \`redirect_uris\` for auth.romaine.life's callback. The whole point is that auth.romaine.life is the only Entra-facing surface; this PR doesn't touch it.

Closes the infra-bootstrap side of [nelsong6/auth#16](https://github.com/nelsong6/auth/issues/16).

## Test plan

- [ ] \`tofu plan\` shows only the SPA URI list being pruned on the existing \`azuread_application.microsoft_login\` resource
- [ ] After apply: auth.romaine.life sign-in still completes (uses the \`web\` flow, unaffected)
- [ ] Confirm via Azure portal that the app reg now has zero SPA redirect URIs and only the \`auth.romaine.life\` web callback under Web
